description: Two silent/surprising default behaviors, each only briefly mentioned on the page it appears on rather than called out prominently: (1) Sync Gateway's default write model is fail-open - read access implies write access unless the sync function explicitly overrides it, the opposite of a default-deny posture; (2) assigning a nonexistent role to a user is a silent no-op rather than an error. Both are the kind of default a reader could easily miss and get surprised by later.
